_comment: Re-run the parameter space a snap-filter pass rejected (scripts/filter_bad_snap_rows.py --rejects-csv). grid.sampling='rerun_csv' rebuilds the grid from the rejects CSV verbatim: every requested column (teff/logg/feh, turbvel, abundances, per-row mu) travels through; lineage and the old faulty marcs_*/correct_* columns are dropped. IMPORTANT: (1) the synthesis block below MUST match the runs the rejects came from (lam window, modes, resolution, NLTE settings) or the re-run will not merge with them; (2) the atmosphere store must contain the spherical (s*) MARCS models, or giants will clamp to logg 3.0 again -- run scripts/download_data.sh --atmospheres MARCS --force first and check `ls <dir> | grep -c '^s'`.
